text:
maya: Quick one — recording of the catalog compare / filters flow https://loom.example/abc. Noting an awkward wrap when you pin a version: the filter pills push to two lines and the pinned tag overlaps the performance badges. Thoughts? sam: saw it — yeah the pinned chip is forcing layout shift. UX-wise we should avoid multiline shift on toggle. jordan: strong vote for keeping the compare toolbar height stable. maybe move the pin indicator into the left of the model row instead of in the filter rail? maya: moving to rows reduces visibility for users who pin globally (want to lock the whole compare, not per-row). preference is a persistent global affordance. alex: what about collapsing low-priority pills into a single "+N" overflow? preserve the pinned chip as sticky at the far right so it never wraps. rui: accessibility note — if we hide pills under "+N" we need keyboard focus and descriptive aria for the overflow. also ensure badges announce changes (aria-live) when metrics update after pinning or model swap. ana: microcopy: current "Pin version" reads fine but is ambiguous about fallback behavior. Suggest "Lock to version (allow fallbacks)" or explicit toggles. maya: +1 on copy clarity. Also the performance badges are quite saturated — they compete with the model title. We should de-emphasize them visually. sam: technical constraints: keeping the toolbar height stable means collapsing pills into a single element and animating width. quick css proof: ``` .pills { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .overflow-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } ``` makes the pill row single-line and avoids vertical shift. alex: for badge visual weight: use 2 color variants — subtle gray for perf badges, saturated accent only for called-out regressions. icons should be outline by default. jordan: agreeable. also show full badge details on hover/focus via tooltip so compactness doesn't hide the data. tooltips must be reachable by keyboard. rui: on aria, sample snippet for the overflow button: ```
...
``` and aria-live region for badge status: `
Latency: 24ms
` so screen readers get updates. maya: UX question — when you pin a version should compare rows freeze their metrics (so pinned view is consistent) or should they continue to reflect live data? sam: freezing on pin is safer for reproducibility. We can add a small live badge with toggle: "Live updates on/off". default: off when pinned. ana: copy for that toggle: "Show live metrics (while pinned)" or shorter "Live metrics" with a tooltip: "When on, pinned compare refreshes metric badges automatically." alex: small nit — pinned indicator should include the version string and a chevron to reveal fallback policy. e.g. "Pinned v3.2 ▾" then a mini menu: "Strict / Allow fallbacks / Auto-fallback to cost-tier". jordan: that menu is great. add a tiny warning icon and clarity text when pin is strict (and automatic fallbacks are disabled). screen-reader text must include current policy. rui: also keyboard shortcut idea: press `v` while focus is on compare to toggle pin state. ensure discoverability in the command palette. maya: design-bot shared a quick Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (updated layout with overflow + pin menu). linking for visual context. design-bot: @maya added a new frame "compare-toolbar/overflow-pin-menu" with states: default/overflow/open-pin-menu/aria-examples. maya: consensus? plan: 1) implement single-line pill overflow with +N popover (dev). 2) move pin to persistent right-side sticky element showing version + policy menu (design). 3) de-emphasize perf badges (design tokens) + tooltips (dev). 4) aria updates: overflow button attributes, aria-live for badges, SR text for pin policy (accessibility). 5) default pinned behaviour: freeze metrics, add opt-in live toggle. sam: I'll create a tech task and estimate impact on horizontal spacing + keyboard nav. alex: will produce a small design token PR for badge tones and icons. jordan: I'll write the copy for pin menu and tooltip drafts. rui: I'll add the aria examples to the accessibility checklist and test with VoiceOver/JAWS once implemented. maya: awesome. small follow-ups: can we make the overflow popover show the same ordering as filter rail? and ensure the "+N" reflects the count of hidden pills (not including pinned). sam: noted. will implement exact counting. alex: :thumbsup: jordan: :shipit: rui: :eyes:
